system_prompt.policy: Extract the author's documented system prompt from the pinned downloaded card, save its hash in the run receipt, and supply exactly the same text to every comparison arm. Do not append arm-specific instructions.

generation.qualification: Native Q8_0 primary pair; earlier two MLX v2 pairs are separate retained failures. Limits common within each pair.

runtime.common_compute_dtype: Q8_0 weights, native mixed-precision Metal kernels
runtime.policy: Official original converted with matching llama.cpp source; CCORE uses verified publisher Q8_0. Quantizer provenance differs; not a controlled full-precision attribution study. Processes run serially through GPU slots and exit before next model. No MTP/speculation.

later_repeated_test.policy: Predeclare seeds and equal attempt/repair budgets; report all runs rather than the best screenshot.

holdout_policy: Never train on this prompt, near-duplicates, these outputs or targeted teacher corrections. Use separate task families for failure-driven training data.

diagnostic_exports.scoring: Exploratory rescue only; never score as a raw pass or fair repair-cost ranking
